name: Smart Visual Ear Cleaner with 1080P HD Camera | Wireless Ear Wax Removal Otoscope | LED Ear Cleaning Tool for Android & iOS | Rechargeable & Portable
description:
Keep your ear care routine more convenient with this Smart Visual Ear Cleaning Kit featuring an HD camera, LED lights, and wireless connectivity. The device allows you to view the ear canal in real time through a compatible smartphone or tablet, helping provide better visibility during inspection and cleaning. Designed with a compact rechargeable body and soft silicone tips, this ear cleaner is easy to handle and suitable for home use. Its wireless design connects with compatible Android and iOS devices through a dedicated app, while the built-in LED lights provide additional illumination for clearer viewing. The portable design makes it convenient for everyday personal care and travel, while the included accessories provide a practical setup for visual ear inspection and cleaning.

Key Features
1080P HD camera for clear real-time ear inspection
Built-in LED lights for improved visibility
Wireless WiFi connectivity with compatible smartphones and tablets
Supports Android and iOS devices through a dedicated app
Soft silicone tips designed for comfortable use
Rechargeable design with convenient USB Type-C charging
Wide-angle visual inspection for better viewing
Adjustable focus for clearer ear canal inspection
Compact and lightweight portable design
Suitable for adults and children with appropriate supervision
Can also be used for general visual inspection of nose, mouth, teeth, skin, and pets

Product Specifications
Product Type: Smart Visual Ear Cleaner / Otoscope
Camera: 1080P HD
Connectivity: Wireless WiFi
Lighting: Built-in LED Lights
Charging Port: Type-C
Focus Range: 10–50mm
Material: Silicone Tips & Electronic Components
Compatibility: Android & iOS Smartphones/Tablets
Application: Ear Inspection & Cleaning

How to Use
Charge the device fully using the Type-C charging cable
Install the compatible app on your smartphone or tablet
Turn on the ear cleaner and connect it to your mobile device
Select a suitable silicone cleaning tip
Open the live camera view on your smartphone
Carefully position the device for visual inspection
Use gentle movements and avoid inserting the tip deeply into the ear canal
Clean the removable tip after use

Material / Composition
Durable Electronic Housing
HD Camera Module
Built-in LED Lights
Soft Silicone Cleaning Tips
Rechargeable Battery
Type-C Charging Port

Safety Information
Use gently and carefully around the ear
Do not insert the device deeply into the ear canal
Do not use on damaged, bleeding, or irritated skin
Stop use immediately if pain or discomfort occurs
Keep the device and charging port away from water
Clean and disinfect suitable removable tips before and after use
Keep small accessories away from young children
For children, use only under responsible adult supervision
This device is intended for personal inspection and cleaning and does not replace professional medical examination

Package Includes
1 × Smart Visual Ear Cleaner with HD Camera
6× Silicone Ear Cleaning Tips
1 × Type-C Charging Cable
1 × User Manual
